public.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
public.description: Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: the root comes first, then the left and right children of each non-null node in queue order; null means absent and trailing nulls may be omitted. Empty arrays mean no root. Return the greatest sum along any nonempty simple path between tree nodes; paths may turn once at a common ancestor. The tree has 1 to 500 nodes; values are integers from -1000 to 1000.
hints: Return the best downward gain while checking a path through both children.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A parent can extend only one branch; the global best may combine two nonnegative child gains. O(n) time and O(height) recursion space.
